diagnosis: The customer is attempting to enable private networking in the ap-south region, which is not supported according to KB article kb-0008. The feature is currently limited to us-east, us-west, and eu-west regions, explaining why the request appears to do nothing rather than fail explicitly.
reply: Thank you for contacting support regarding private networking. Based on our current availability, private networking is only supported in the us-east, us-west, and eu-west regions and is not yet available in ap-south. Requests made in unsupported regions are queued rather than returning an error, which explains the behavior you are seeing. Please refer to our documentation on regional availability for further details.
